title: 2x2 mesh, 4-node TP ALLGATHER (ring, k=2 boundary), 1024 B payload

expected.notes: PW2 audit: ring ALLGATHER at the k=2 boundary. Oracle laws: messages = k(k-1) = 2, one step, each neighbour edge carries exactly one message of B bytes. Guards against step-count off-by-one at the degenerate ring.
